parameter_provenance.dimension_weights: agreed shadow design prior; not fitted to benchmark rankings
parameter_provenance.evidence_tiers: frozen versioned scoring rule over upstream evidence_tier; offline review does not block scoring
parameter_provenance.evidence_mix: 0.8 * best upstream tier + 0.2 * reproduced test category coverage
parameter_provenance.symptom_activation: 0.8 root activation baseline + 0.2 marginal symptom coverage

replay_semantics.replay_complete: all mandatory trigger cases reproduce on the same frozen source snapshot with a valid environment and Oracle
replay_semantics.replay_partial: at least one but not all mandatory trigger cases reproduce; infrastructure failures do not qualify
replay_semantics.conflict: mandatory trigger cases fail to reproduce on the same snapshot with a valid environment and Oracle
replay_semantics.inconclusive: snapshot changed, infrastructure incomplete, or Oracle validity cannot be established; no negative evidence credit
